relevance_gate.policy: Registry aliases/concepts must independently support topic relevance; ambiguous one-word craft/science anchors require an instructional title signal.

pedagogy_gate.policy: Require topic evidence plus explicit instructional intent; recognize documentary and museum/gallery teaching formats while rejecting clickbait and entertainment-shaped titles.

selection_gate.policy: Automatic selection requires instructional evidence alongside the topic anchor, favoring explicit tutorials, lectures, overviews, courses, demonstrations, documentaries, and museum/gallery talks.

title_quality_gate.policy: Automatic topic selection must be visibly anchored in the media title using a topic-specific vocabulary.
